title: Unrestricted codes (q-ary and mixed binary/ternary) with the most words
keeper: A. E. Brouwer, tables of bounds on codes (aeb.win.tue.nl/codes)
revision: binary-1.html, ternary-1.html, quaternary-1.html, 5ary-1.html and 23codes.html read 15 Nov 2026 10:43-10:44 UTC (SHA-256 of each in page_sha256)

template.title: Code over an alphabet of {q} symbols, length {n}, minimum distance {d}
template.statement: Find a code of length {n} over an alphabet of {q} symbols in which every two words differ in at least {d} coordinates, with as many words as possible (A_{q}({n},{d})).
template.submission: Text file: one word per line, {n} symbols below {q} (separated by spaces or written as one string of digits); see checkers/ucode_check.py.

aq.title: Code over an alphabet of {q} symbols, length {n}, minimum distance {d}

mixed.title: Mixed code with {m} binary and {n} ternary coordinates, minimum distance {d}
mixed.statement: Find a code whose words have {m} binary coordinates followed by {n} ternary ones, in which every two words differ in at least {d} coordinates, with as many words as possible (N({m},{n},{d}) of Brouwer, Hamalainen, Ostergard and Sloane).
mixed.submission: Text file: one word per line, {m} binary symbols then {n} ternary symbols (separated by spaces or written as one string of digits); see checkers/ucode_check.py.

score: the number of words (larger is better)
best_text: The best known lower bound in Brouwer's table is {best}; a code with more words improves it.
bound_source: the upper bound in the same table
holder_unknown: the tables give values; the references and notes on each page name the constructions
holder_sources: the notes and references on the page of the table
open_rule: every entry of the tables of A_2(n,d), A_3(n,d), A_4(n,d), A_5(n,d) and N(m,n,d) (m, n >= 1) whose lower bound is below its upper bound, with a lower bound below 2^17
